page.layout: One printed page: one column of running text. Running head at top centre. Signature at bottom left, catchword at bottom right. No marginal notes or footnotes. Left edge shows the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.l: delibandos, & vicissim in ea pij exponunt vota
sua & professiones quasque pietatis suæ, vt co-
ram Domino acceptæ sint in vnitate corporis
Christi. Hanc fidelem depositariam olim ap-
pellabant pij, cùm Hierofolyma nominarent:
idque iisdem modis, quos proximè declaraui-
mus cùm de portis Hierofolymorū ageremus. Vrbs enim Hierofolymorū
aut secundum naturalem illam materiam, aut se-
cundum figuram, aut secundùm veritatem à sanctis illis homini-
bus enunciata est. Hïc triplex modus simul
concurrebat; cùm pij verbis Prophetæ istis vte-
rentur: Nam & materiam Ierufalem vide-
bant, & figuram cernebat qua vestiebatur ma-
teriata Ierufalem instituto Dei, & in veritate
velut anima illius conquiescebant, quia Deus
præsentiam suam gratiosam prolixè in ea con-
firmabat.
Prodest autem piis huiusmodi Ecclesiæ ap-
pellatio plurimum, facto, & exemplo. Facto
prodest, quia singvli hoc facto officium suum
erga Ecclesiam probant (quid enim piæ matri
non debeant pij filij?) & quia Ecclesiam prouo-
cant ad officia in prolem mortigeram & officio-
sam maiore cū fructu & alacritate maiore præ-
standa: Illi præstamus singvli personalia officia
nostra; illa verò dispensat nobis tùm
communia omnibus quæ habet, tam etiam singulis per-
sonalia ad ædificationem nostram. Atque hoc
illud est quod ante diximus, Ecclesiæ partes

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "mortigeram" (scan shows "mórigeram" with unclear accent), "tùm" (printed "tuny", read as tùm), "ma-teriata" hyphen kept as printed. "Hierofolymorū" with macron as printed. The page number is printed in old-style 3 and marked [?]. Faint marks at top right corner are probably show-through or stray marks and are not transcribed. Left edge strip is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
